property_summary: Through an ERC1967 proxy, after initialize(accessControl) succeeds, c.setSlopes must succeed for any valid kink because the stored access-control contract grants access; the mutant never stores the access-control address, so the access check consults address(0) and reverts.
change_summary: Remove the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the accessControl address is never set.
